_meta.purpose: Structured register of unresolved/unknown global mechanics

gaps.question: What is the exact EXP required per player level (z5 function)?
gaps.current_knowledge: z5(i) is called on level-up with i = level-r+1 for r in 1..level. Function defined in items bundle (export as 'z5') but body not extracted from current minified source. z5 is imported in main bundle.
gaps.best_evidence: grep shows z5(i) called at level-up, loops r=JC(this,o) down to 1
gaps.blocking_dependency: Need to locate z5 function definition in items bundle (likely renamed via minification)
gaps.next_verification_method: Static extraction of z5 body from bundle, OR run client locally with debugger

gaps.question: Exact party EXP split formula and +2%/member bonus implementation
gaps.current_knowledge: UI strings describe split merata + 2% per member max 12, within 10 level diff. Runtime defeat events show baseExp variance (271-4310 at Lv90) consistent with party modifier but cannot isolate formula.
gaps.best_evidence: TRANSLATIONS.json contains party bonus descriptions; 800+ defeat events show variance
gaps.blocking_dependency: Controlled party experiments (1 member, 2 members same mob) — requires guest accounts

gaps.question: Actual server drop rates vs client-displayed constants
gaps.current_knowledge: Client constants: equipment 1.25%, card 0.1%, bossCard 1%, etc. These are DISPLAY rates (var ie in items bundle). Server may use different values.
gaps.best_evidence: 800+ defeat events + drops — sample size too small to distinguish 1.25% from 1.0% or 1.5%
gaps.blocking_dependency: Large-scale drop logging (>10K kills per mob) OR server disassembly
gaps.next_verification_method: Statistical hypothesis testing on drop frequencies

gaps.question: Server refine success formula vs client formula
gaps.current_knowledge: Client formula: successRate = 1 - Ca(level)*(1-refine/100), Ca=min(0.3,max(0,(level-20)*0.0025)). Refine caps 10 bonus stats.
gaps.best_evidence: Client code Ic() at offset ~273 in items bundle
gaps.blocking_dependency: Empirical refine attempts logged with outcomes
gaps.next_verification_method: Track N refine attempts across levels

gaps.question: Exact damage variance/randomness model
gaps.current_knowledge: Basic factor has variance (observed max/min ratio up to 4.059 in multi-hit). Crit is per-cast roll. No evidence of additional random roll.
gaps.best_evidence: 342 incoming damage events, 2940+ outgoing, multi-hit variance analysis
gaps.blocking_dependency: Paired damage samples (same player/skill/mob, many hits)

gaps.question: Monster stats (ATK/DEF/MDEF/FLEE) exact formulas beyond FLEE=100+2*level
gaps.current_knowledge: Mob FLEE = 100 + 2*level (verified). Mob HP from MONSTER_DB (40 species). Mob ATK/DEF/MDEF/HIT not in client data (server-authoritative).
gaps.best_evidence: Client has FLEE formula; incoming damage events give mobDamage before DEF subtraction
gaps.blocking_dependency: Reverse-engineer from incoming damage events with known player DEF
gaps.next_verification_method: Statistical inference from incoming damage distribution

gaps.question: PvP damage formula and hit/flee mechanics
gaps.current_knowledge: Arena exists (Aurelia Arena PVP อิสระ). Changelog mentions PVP damage reduction ('ดวล PvP ไม่ตายในทีเดีวัน'). No runtime PvP combat data captured.
gaps.best_evidence: Arena map in GAME_DB, changelog PVP entry 2026-09-24-pvp-damage-tenth
gaps.blocking_dependency: PvP combat logging (not done — would require arena participation)
gaps.next_verification_method: Code search for PVP damage modifier + arena combat logging

gaps.question: Skill cast time formula (not just cooldown)
gaps.current_knowledge: Skill cooldowns in skill table (500-30000ms). Cast time / animation lock not documented.
gaps.best_evidence: Skill table has cooldown_ms field; no cast_time field
gaps.blocking_dependency: Runtime measurement of skill animation duration

gaps.question: Attack cooldown vs ASPD relationship for skills
gaps.current_knowledge: cooldownFromAspd flag exists on some skills (bash, doublestrafe, arrowshower). Basic attack interval = (200-ASPD)*20ms. Skill cooldown may or may not scale.
gaps.blocking_dependency: Runtime measurement of skill attack cadence
gaps.next_verification_method: Time consecutive skill attacks at different ASPD

gaps.question: Bank/storage capacity formula
gaps.current_knowledge: Premium increases capacity (UI string). Base capacity unknown.
